title: Glomerular Filtration Rate by Bedside Schwartz

outputs.label: Glomerular Filtration Rate
outputs.expr: (0.413 * height / serum_creat) if (doCalc) else (0.413 * height / serum_creat)

notes: The original Schwartz Formula was based on serum creatinine measured by the Jaffe method.
This updated formula is based on serum creatinine measured by enzymatic assay.
content.data_input_disclaimer: ONLY DIGITS 0 TO 9 AND A SINGLE DECIMAL POINT (".") ARE ACCEPTABLE AS NUMERIC INPUTS. ATTEMPTED INPUT OF OTHER CHARACTERS INTO A NUMERIC FIELD MAY LEAD TO AN INCORRECT RESULT.
